{{Top|leg}}
'''Ignition chambers''' were components used in engines. [[Jetpack/Legends|Jetpacks]] had ignition chambers where an intake mechanism pulled in the surrounding [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] and mixed it with small amounts of fuel to produce thrust. [[Bespin Motors/Legends|Bespin Motors]] [[Methane Sifter Ramjet]] used a compressed ignition chamber into which gases like [[Methane/Legends|methane]] or [[Ammonia/Legends|ammonia]] were drawn into and then burned to produce energy to power the vessel's [[hover vane]]s.
